主要内容: The Progressive Corporation (NYSE: PGR) reported its August 2019 results, showing a 13% increase in net premiums written to $2,921.3 million compared to $2,591.3 million in August 2018. Net premiums earned rose by 14% to $2,784.4 million. However, net income attributable to Progressive decreased by 36% to $175.9 million from $274.7 million in the same period last year. The per share available to common shareholders also dropped by 36% to $0.30 from $0.46. The company's combined ratio increased slightly to 93.4 from 92.3. Policies in force for personal lines grew by 11% to 19,066.9, with a 12% increase in direct auto policies. The company also reported a 10% increase in companywide total policies in force to 21,935.9. The financial results for The Progressive Corporation and its subsidiaries for the period ending August 2019 show a net income attributable to Progressive of $2,618.6 million, compared to $2,100.6 million in the prior year. The company also reported comprehensive income attributable to Progressive of $3,381.7 million, reflecting a significant increase from $1,931.7 million in the previous year. The GAAP ratios for the company include a loss/LAE ratio of 72.7%, an expense ratio of 18.7%, and a combined ratio of 91.4%. These figures indicate the company's performance in managing its underwriting and operational costs. The report also highlights the impact of actuarial adjustments on the financial results, particularly for the Property business, where the loss/LAE ratio was influenced by favorable reinsurance recoverables and amortization expenses. The company's investment results show a fully taxable equivalent (FTE) total return of 0.9% for the total portfolio, with fixed-income securities yielding 1.2% and common stocks returning (1.9)%.
